groups.title: Role-Based Access Control
groups.question: Explain how you would decide what each user is allowed to do in an application.

followUps.RBAC Design & Enforcement: Why must permission checks run on the server, even when the UI already hides the button?
followUps.Principle of Least Privilege: How does giving a service only the permissions it needs limit the damage of a breach?

groups.title: Attribute-Based Access Control
groups.question: Explain how you handle permission rules that roles alone can't express, like "only the owner, during business hours".

followUps.ABAC & Policy-Based Authorization: Give a rule that needs attributes instead of roles, and how it would be checked.
followUps.Open Policy Agent (OPA): What do you gain by moving authorization rules out of the application code into OPA?

groups.title: OWASP Authorization Guidance
groups.question: Explain the ways users reach data or actions they shouldn't, and how you stop each one.

followUps.Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR): What is an IDOR, and what check fixes it?
followUps.Vertical vs. Horizontal Privilege Escala: What is the difference between vertical and horizontal privilege escalation? Give an example of each.

groups.title: API Authorization Patterns
groups.question: Explain how you limit what a token can do in an API, and how the database can back that up.

followUps.OAuth Scopes & Resource Servers: A token has only a read scope. What must the API check before it allows a write?
followUps.Row-Level & Column-Level Security: How does row-level security protect data even when a bug skips the check in the app code?
